_classes.name: designation_no_actor gate drops real duties/powers (passive 'will be issued', BOCES list-item power)
_classes.rule: dropped/*.json rule=='designation_no_actor' and quote matches r'\b(will be|shall|may|to enter into|is authorized)\b' (narrow; 315 total designation_no_actor drops need review, list-item powers like S6358-23 carry no verb)

_classes.name: beneficiary entitlement/rate stored as duty ('Interest shall be allowed', 'shall not be required to pay')
_classes.rule: duties where quote ~ /interest shall be allowed|shall not be required to pay|shall be entitled to (a|an|the)? ?(benefit|refund|credit|payment)/i

_classes.name: approver of another record's action stored as its own duty ('as determined by X and approved by the director of the budget')
_classes.rule: quote contains 'approved by', actor_raw appears only after the last 'approved by' and not before it

_classes.name: relocated quote is the amending instruction ('... is amended to read as follows:'), no operative language
_classes.rule: quote_relocated and quote ~ /is (hereby )?amended to read as follows:?\s*$/

_classes.name: act-clause duty to notify the legislative bill drafting commission not recorded (recorded in 22 records elsewhere, so policy is inconsistent)
_classes.rule: packet LAW TEXT ~ /shall notify the legislative bill drafting commission/i and no stored record for the law quotes 'bill drafting commission' (count = laws)

_classes.name: extensions/widenings by deleted sunset or re-dated chapter not recorded (sunset deletion, 'expire 36 years ... may be renewed', ch.111/2010 Part A to 2015, 'during weekdays' struck)
_classes.rule: no mechanical rule: needs reading of what the extended provision empowers

_classes.name: licensing-discipline consequences for agencies not recorded ('shall constitute cause ... for the revocation', 'shall subject ... to disciplinary action')
_classes.rule: judgment: penalty clauses that empower an agency

_classes.name: identical sentence for a second named body collapsed (BERS transfer duty, Ed Law 2575(20)(e)(3), same words as TRS 13-582(o))
_classes.rule: judgment: same quote appearing twice in a packet for different bodies with one stored record
